ohtani.title: Oli Marmol recaps Cardinals' 8-6 win over Dodgers
ohtani.blurb: Oli Marmol talks the Cardinals rebounding after getting in a 3-0 deficit, Thomas Saggese's big game and more following the Cardinals' win vs. Dodgers

imanaga.title: Shota Imanaga's strong start leads Cubs to 6-1 win
imanaga.blurb: Shota Imanaga tosses six dominant innings and Michael Busch slugs a home run to lead the Cubs to a 6-1 win over the Marlins

suzuki.title: Five-run rally, pair of homers lead Marlins' 10-3 win
suzuki.blurb: A five-run rally in the 5th inning, plus homers from Heriberto Hernández and Javier Sanoja power the Marlins' 10-3 win over the Cubs

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Perez, Pasquantino spark Royals' offense in 6-1 win
okamoto.blurb: Salvador Perez and Vinnie Pasquantino launch home runs to power the offense in Royals' 6-1 victory over the Blue Jays

murakami.title: Kyle Teel, Sam Antonacci fuel the White Sox 10-1 win
murakami.blurb: Kyle Teel crushes a three-run home run and Sam Antonacci hits a two-run double to lead the White Sox to a 10-1 win over the White Sox

matsui.title: Campusano, Buehler lead Padres to 3-2 win
matsui.blurb: Six strikeouts from Walker Buehler and a walk-off two-run home run from Luis Campusano lead the Padres to a 3-2 win over the Yankees
